entries.clue: Shallow drum with rattling wires beneath, giving a marching beat its crack
Funnel that drops from a black sky, shreds barns and earns a Fujita rating.
Hidden split in a glacier, bridged over by treacherous drifted snow
Named Atlantic monster with a calm eye and coast-wrecking winds.
Dog-driving Norwegian who reached 90 degrees south five weeks ahead
Vast coiled brass anchoring a band's low end with a rumbling oompah
Two feet of silver blown sideways across a hole, airy and pure up at the top
Deep-voiced strings gripped between the knees and sung by a horsehair bow
Thin cane sliver that buzzes against a mouthpiece to start the sound
Half-melted mix, neither proper flakes nor plain drops, stinging your face.
Drifting slab of frozen sea a beset ship may be pinned among
